vulnerability_analysis: The contract allows the owner to set fees up to 50% on both buy and sell sides. The marketingWallet and devWallet initially point to the owner. By setting high sell fees and updating the fee recipient wallets to the attacker's address, selling tokens will cause a large portion of the sale to be collected as fees and sent to the attacker.
attack_strategy: Impersonate owner, enable trading, set maximum sell fees (50%), update fee recipient wallets to attacker, acquire tokens, sell tokens to trigger fee collection, profit from ETH distribution.
step_by_step_plan:
1. Impersonate owner using vm.prank
2. Call enableTrading()
3. Call updateSellFees(25, 25, 0) for 50% total
4. Call updateMarketingWallet(attacker) and updateDevWallet(attacker)
5. Get MARVIN tokens (transfer from owner or buy from pair)
6. Sell tokens through Uniswap router
7. Verify attacker ETH balance increased
